props.name: placeholder
props.description: Trigger text when nothing is chosen.

props.name: showChips
props.description: Show the chosen values as removable Chips under the trigger.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which side of the trigger it opens on. Flips when it would leave the viewport.

props.name: align
props.description: How it lines up with the trigger along that side.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as failing validation. Pair it with a message.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Overrides the generated id. Useful when a label lives elsewhere.
